products.name: Ambition Storm Wand Wireless Tattoo Machine Pen
products.description:
Once you go wireless,you will love Ambition tattoo machine. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.
Material: space aluminium alloy
Needle Stroke: 4.0mm
Motor: custom Coreless Motor. Ambition Coreless motor is good with lining, shading, color packing, lettering, traditional, neotraditional.
Motor Speed: 10V - 9000RPM
Battery Capacity: 1950mAh, biult-in 3x 650mAh lithium battery
Charging time: 1.5-2 hours
Operation time: Under normal 8V voltage, the voltage stable state can last for more than 6 hours,long time working the voltage is stable.
Output fixed current：2A
Working voltage: 3.7V
Output Voltage : 5V-12V
LED display content: output voltage range + battery usage + working time
Instructions for use:
- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds
- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.5V on each press.
- Working time: The working time can be accurate to minutes. When the power is turned off, the time will be cleared. When the output is paused, it will also stop counting.


(Single Battery)Package Included: Ambition tattoo machine includes 1pc wireless tattoo machine, 1pc RCA adapter, 1pc extra 4.0mm stroke cam, 1pc power cable, 1pc zipper box.

(Dual Battery)Package Included: Ambition tattoo machine includes 1pc wireless tattoo machine, 1pc extra battery, 1pc RCA adapter, 1pc extra 4.0mm stroke cam, 1pc power cable, 1pc zipper box.

Tips: Our products are 100% brand new. There is a protective film on the screen. There may be a small amount of scratches during the production, packaging and transportation. Just tear off the protective film after receiving the machine.

2400mAh Large Battery Capacity

 

  1. The real capacity of the vibe battery is 2400 mAh. After many tests, a fully charged battery can work for more than 7 hours at an output voltage of 8V, and the two batteries can be used for more than 14 hours in total.
  2. The battery can be fully charged about 3 hours with the Type-C fast charging cable. And the battery is equipped with a 10V jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed.

 

 

High-sensitivity Touch Buttons

 

  1. The battery of the vibe tattoo machine adopts high-sensitivity touch buttons, which changes the button method of the traditional wireless battery pen. It only needs to gently place your finger on the button.
  2. High-sensitivity touch buttons can be used even if you wear tattoo gloves or the machine is covered with a machine cover bag.

 

 

Multifunction LED Display

 

  1. The vibe cordless gun machine adopts LED digital display screen, which is equipped with various machine data. It displays the machine's working voltage, current, remaining power, Hertz and timer. These data can help tattoo artists to clearly know the working status of the machine and meet daily tattooing needs.
  2. The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely. The working voltage of the vibe machine is 4.5V-12V, the frequency of 4.5V working voltage is about 72 Hz, and the frequency of 12V is about 196 Hz. Its frequency will change with voltage regulation, adjust power by 0.1.

 

 

Brushless Motor

 

  1. The vibe wireless tattoo machine built-in a brushless motor and 4.0mm stainless steel stroke cam. The brushless motor greatly prolongs the service life of the machine, and is more powerful and quieter than the coreless motor.
  2. The 4.0 stainless steel stroke cam is not easy to wear and deform, it makes the machine have good balance between lines and shading, and perfect for demanding lining and color packing.

products.name: Ambition Vibe Tattoo Machine Brushless Motor
products.description:
Once you go wireless, you will love Ambition tattoo machine equipment. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.

Material: space aluminum alloy

Needle Stroke: 4.0mm

Motor: brushless motor, not only long lifespan,Durable motor Precise parts and professional design Brings longevity and quiet running

A direct drive tattoo machine pen that offers 4 mm stroke, the tattoo machine excels in lining, shading and colour packing, and is also very quiet to run and creates more lower vibration.

Motor Speed: 12V - 10000RPM

Power Supply: 4.5-12 Volts; 73-195 Hertz

The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely.

Single Battery Capacity: 2400mAh (4800mAh for 2 batteries)

Charging time: about 3 hours

One battery operation time: More than 10 hours (20 hours for 2 batteries)

Output Voltage : 4.5V-12V, stitch frequency:73 -195 Hz

LED display content: output voltage range + working time + battery usage+Hertz+Ampere

Instructions for use:

- Power ON/OFF: Touch "O" key for 3 seconds

- Output pause / resume: Touch "O" key to pause the output, and touch it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).

- Adjust output voltage: Touch the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each touch.

Tattoo Power Supply: The LED display will show the remaining power percentage. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging Type-c data cable can usually be fully charged about 3 hours.

Notice: The touch button will be more sensitive than the ordinary button, try to avoid touching the switch button when changing the needle or adjust the needle length so you will not get hurt.
products.short_description: Machine Size: The ambition vibe machine is the same size as the soldier machine, 145mm in length and 32mm in diameter. We upgraded the material and made it with high hardness aluminum alloy material, which reduced the weight of this vibe tattoo pen t

products.description:
Tattoo Power Supply - Ambition G4 Professional Portable RCA Wireless Tattoo 1950mAh Lithium Battery Supply with LCD Digital Display for Rotary Tattoo Pen Machine Gun

Material : space aluminium alloy + high quality insulating plastic

Connector : RCA Charging time : 2 hours

Operation time : After fully charged, this battery can work continuously for 6-8 hours, or even longer. It depends on personal usage and tattoo machine.

Output fixed current : 2A Working voltage : 3.7V Charging voltage : DC 5V±0.5V 1000mAh

Output voltage : 5-12V

Adjustment interval : ±0.5V

LCD display content : output voltage range + battery usage + timer

Instructions for use:

- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds

- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).

- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.5V on each press.

- Working time: The working time can be accurate to minutes. When the power is turned off, the time will be cleared. When the output is paused, it will also stop counting.

Power: The LCD display will show the remaining power, and the full power will display 4 divisions. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging USB data cable can usually be fully charged in 1.5-2 hours.

Please pay attention to the change of power at any time to prevent sudden power loss from affecting your tattooing work.

products.name: TREX-Needles-RM-1005
products.description:
Ambition TREX cartridge needles are disposable single-use, allow tattoo artists to set up needles and switch needle configuration very quickly during tattooing process.

 

  • Cartridges come with membrane to prevent ink leakage to the tube or machine.
  • Semi transparent & bevil tips make it easier to observe the needle striking.
  • Compatible with All types cartridge grips & machines. No Allen keys required.
  • Made of 316L surgical stainless steel and medical grade plastic.
  • E.O. sterilized and packaged in blister pack.
  • Package include 1 boxes, 20pcs per box, totally 20pcs.

 

Cartridge needles diameter and taper specification:

 

  • Needle Diameter--

 

#08 Bugpin 0.25mm

#10 Bugpin 0.3mm

#12 Regular 0.35mm

 

  • Taper--

 

RL means Round Liner Long Taper about 5.5mm

RM means Curved Magnum Medium Taper about 3.5mm

products.name: FKCDDY-Black
products.description:
Xnet tattoo power supply work with the majority of RCA rotary tattoo pen machines and assist tattoo artists enjoy portability and ease of use.
How to Use:
1. Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 2-3 seconds
2. Press the up and down power button 5V-12V power cycle replacement
3.Output Pause / Resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output (the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
4.Adjust Output Voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. display shows 5-12V, each adjustment ±1V.
5. When full charging, the indicator light is always on.
Specification:
Material: Aluminium alloy and high quality insulating plastic
Start Voltage: 8V
Output Voltage: 5-12V
Charging Method: Type-C
Interface: RCA interface
Battery Capacity: 4800mAh
Charging Time: About 4 hours
Working Time: About 20 hours
Size: Approx. 3.14inches X 2.28inches X 1inches
Weight：6.7oz
Package:
1 x Xnet Tattoo power supply,1X 1.8mRCA Clip cord,1X Type-C charge cable

products.name: Xnet Plus-Red
products.description:
Ambition Rotary Tattoo Battery Pen Wireless Cartridge Machine with 1950mAh Power Supply Coreless Motor Digital LED Display Permanent Make Up Equipment for Professionals Tattoo Artists

Material: space aluminium alloy

Needle Stroke: 4.0mm

Motor: Coreless Motor. Ambition Coreless motor is good with lining, shading, color packing, lettering, traditional, neotraditional.

Motor Speed: 10V - 9000RPM

Battery Capacity: 1950mAh, biult-in 3x 650mAh lithium battery

Charging time: 1.5-2 hours

Operation time: Under normal 8V voltage, the voltage stable state can last for more than 6 hours,long time working the voltage is stable.

Output fixed current：2A

Working voltage: 3.7V

Output Voltage : 5V-12V

LED display content: output voltage range + battery usage + working time

Instructions for use:

- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds

- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).

- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.5V on each press.

- Working time: The working time can be accurate to minutes. When the power is turned off, the time will be cleared. When the output is paused, it will also stop counting.

Power: The LED display will show the remaining power, and the full power will display 4 divisions. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging USB data cable can usually be fully charged in 1.5-2 hours.

Please pay attention to the change of power at any time to prevent sudden power loss from affecting your tattooing work.

Tips: Our products are 100% brand new. There is a protective film on the screen. There may be a small amount of scratches during the production, packaging and transportation. Just tear off the protective film after receiving the product.

2400mAh Large Battery Capacity

 

  1. The real capacity of the vibe battery is 2400 mAh. After many tests, a fully charged battery can work for more than 7 hours at an output voltage of 8V, and the two batteries can be used for more than 14 hours in total.
  2. The battery can be fully charged about 3 hours with the Type-C fast charging cable. And the battery is equipped with a 10V jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed.

    High-sensitivity Touch Buttons

     

    1. The battery of the vibe tattoo machine adopts high-sensitivity touch buttons, which changes the button method of the traditional wireless battery pen. It only needs to gently place your finger on the button.
    2. High-sensitivity touch buttons can be used even if you wear tattoo gloves or the machine is covered with a machine cover bag.

      Multifunction LED Display

       

      1. The vibe cordless gun machine adopts LED digital display screen, which is equipped with various machine data. It displays the machine's working voltage, current, remaining power, Hertz and timer. These data can help tattoo artists to clearly know the working status of the machine and meet daily tattooing needs.
      2. The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely. The working voltage of the vibe machine is 4.5V-12V, the frequency of 4.5V working voltage is about 72 Hz, and the frequency of 12V is about 196 Hz. Its frequency will change with voltage regulation, adjust power by 0.1.

products.name: Ambition Zetton Wireless Tattoo Machine Pen
products.description:
Once you go wireless, you will love Ambition tattoo machine equipment. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.
Material: Aluminum alloy
Straight Bar Drive Stroke Cam: 3.4mm&3.8mm
Motor: brushless motor, not only long lifespan,Durable motor Precise parts and professional design Brings longevity and quiet running
A direct drive tattoo machine pen that performs well for both lining and shading, and is also very quiet to run and creates more lower vibration.
Straight Bar Drive Stroke Cam,offers powerful hitting, less resistance. Motor Speed: 8V - 10000RPM
Power Supply: 4.5-12 Volts; 56-168 Hertz
The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely.
Single Battery Capacity: 2400mAh (4800mAh for 2 batteries)
Charging time: about 2-3 hours
One battery operation time: More than 8 hours (16 hours for 2 batteries)
LED display content: output voltage range + working time + battery usage+Hertz
Instructions for use:
- Power ON/OFF: Press the "Ambition" key for 3 seconds
- Output pause / resume: Press "Ambition" key to pause the output, and press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
- Adjust output voltage:3 voltage modes: fixed voltage（4 memory modes corresponding to5V/7V/9V/11V Touch the middle of thedisplay to switch modes）, increase/decrease by 0.1V（Slide the display left and right to adjustthe voltage by 0.1v), and increase/decrease by 1V（Touch the red arrow icons on the displayto adjust the voltage by 1V).
The touch button will be more sensitive than the ordinary button, automatically lock the screen 3 minutes after power-on, swipe up to deactivate the lock mode.

 

Package Include:
Single Battery Version：1 X wireless tattoo machine, 1X extra 3.4mm stroke cam ,1X RCA clip cord,1X power cord,1X zipper box.

Dual Battery Version：1 X wireless tattoo machine, 1X extra battery,1X extra 3.4mm stroke cam ,1X RCA clip cord,1X power cord,1X zipper box.

products.name: Soldier-Kit 2-Black
products.description:
Once you go wireless, you will love Ambition tattoo machine equipment. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.
Material: space aluminium alloy Needle Stroke: 4.0mm Motor: Coreless Motor. Ambition Coreless motor is good with lining, shading, color packing, lettering, traditional, neotraditional.
Motor Speed: 10V - 9000RPM One Battery Capacity: 2400mAh, built-in 3x 800mAh lithium battery Charging time: 2-3 hours
Operation time: Under normal 8V voltage, the voltage stable state can last for more than 10 hours, long time working the voltage is stable.
Output fixed current：2A Working voltage: 3.7V Output Voltage : 5V-12V LED display content: output voltage range + battery usage + working time
Instructions for use:
- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds
- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each press. - Working time: The working time can be accurate to minutes. When the power is turned off, the time will be cleared. When the output is paused, it will also stop counting.
Power: The LED display will show the remaining power, and the full power will display 4 divisions. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging cable can usually be fully charged in 2-3 hours. Please pay attention to the change of power at any time to prevent sudden power loss from affecting your tattooing work.

products.name: Xnet Vipera Adjustable Stroke Wireless Tattoo Machine Pen
products.description:
XNET Vipera Adjustable Stroke Wireless Tattoo Machine

Product Information

Xnet Vipera Adjustable Stroke Tattoo Machine:

 

  • Weight: 275g/0.61lb
  • Length: 145mm/5.71inches
  • Grip Part Diameter: 36mm/1.42inches
  • 7 Strokes to Adjust: from 2.4mm to 4.2mm
  • Motor: Coreless Motor
  • Battery Capacity: 2400mAh (it need 2-3 hours to full charge, runs for 8-10 hours)
  • Voltage Range: 4-12V

 

More Details of Vipera Tattoo Machine:

Adjustable Stroke

Xnet tattoo machine gun has 7 stroke options from 2.4mm to 4.2mm which can be adjusted at will, suitable for all kinds of tattoos, perfect for lining, shading and color packing. You can change the strokes easily by turning the adjustment knob.

Color Display Battery

Xnet wireless tattoo machine has 2400mAh capacity color display battery, which displays the remaining power, timer, operating voltage, Herz. Also, you can adjust the working voltage by pressing the "+" "-" keys from 4V to 12V.

Wirelss & Wired Mode

The battery can be used for 8-10 hours when fully charged, which basically meets the needs of a tattoo artist for a day's work. If you forget to charge, there is a RCA adapter coming with the machine which can change to wired mode.

Standard Interface

Our Xnet Vipera tattoo machine pen uses a standard needle port and is suitable for most tattoo needles on the market. The coreless motor is powerful enough to push large rows of tattoo needles easily.

products.name: Xnet Bestia Adjustable Stroke Wireless Tattoo Machine Pen
products.description:
Xnet Tattoo Equipment Supply

Xnet Bestia Ajustable Stroke Wireless Tattoo Machine

ABOUT XNET:

XNET is a company that focuses on tattoo equipment supplies. We aim to allow tattoo artists to find a tattoo machine that suits them well and can do more amazing works for clients. We are truly grateful for those who supports us, we are still growing and believe tomorrow will be better!

 

More Details of Bestia Rotary Cartridge Tattoo Pen

2400mAh Battery with Color Screen

Xnet tattoo gun can display remaining power, timer, voltage and herz. 2400 mAh battery, takes 2-3 hours to fully charge, can last for 8-10 hours. Importantly, double-click the power button to switch between two modes, the blue one is the standard mode, and the green one is the 8V strong start mode.

Adjustable Stroke Tattoo Pen

There are 7 needle stroke lengths for you to choose from 2.4mm to 4.2mm, rotate the stroke adjustment area on the grip to switch between different strokes, which basically meets the various needs of tattoo artists. This Xnet Bestia tattoo machine pen is perfect for lining, shading and color packing.

Two Modes for You to Choose

The 2400mAh removable battery makes working wherever possible. Also, there is a RCA adapter and a RCA capble coming with the machine, you can choose traditional power supply method when you forgetting to charge battery. Easily switch wireless mode to wired mode can keep you away from power anxiety.

Standard Tattoo Needle Interface

Xnet Bestia rotary cartridge tattoo machine gun uses standard tattoo needle interface, suitable for most tattoo needles on the market. This tattoo gun pushes tatoo ink smoothly and precisely to skins and have less skin loss. Besides, 8V strong start function makes using large pin tattoo needle easy.

Bestia Tattoo Machine Package Includes:
